title: Rightward update of a lane configuration
statement: Let a base configuration, work tape, optional state $q$, state $q'$, integer $z$, lists $l,r$, and optional symbols $a,b$ be given. Applying the action that writes $b$ on the designated tape, moves its head right, and enters state $q'$ to the lane configuration with frontier $z$, left list $l$, and right list $a::r$ gives the lane configuration with state $q'$, frontier $z+1$, left list $b::l$, and right list $r$.
replaced:
Let a single-lane configuration be given whose unprocessed list begins with an entry
$s$.  Applying the single-lane action that writes an entry $s'$ on the lane, moves
right, and enters a state $q$ yields again a single-lane configuration: the state
becomes $q$, the coordinate advances by one, $s'$ is pushed onto the processed list,
$s$ is removed from the unprocessed list, and all other tapes and heads are unchanged.
